summary: Bergman & Beving AB (publ) provides solutions for the manufacturing and construction sectors in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Benelux, the Baltics, Denmark, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Core Solutions, Safety Technology, Machinery & Equipment, and PPE & Utilities. It offers fasteners, metal roofs, heat exchangers, and inspection hatches, as well as wooden wedges, laminate panels, temporary protective coatings for window surfaces, and wall and roof hatches. The company also provides personal fall protection products, and rescue and evacuation equipment; pressure and temperature instrumentation products; photonic printing solutions; stainless steel pipe works; safety signages; fire alarm systems; standard safety signs; life-saving products; protection and safety products for logistics, warehouses, and other business premises; workplace safety solutions; and measurement and control systems for liquid logistics in the oil, gas, chemical, and aviation industries. In addition, it offers modular FLEX functional test systems; sheet-metal machinery; ergonomic paving, bricklaying, plastering, and concrete tools; standardized weighing systems, scales, and components; laboratory equipment; custom color solutions; tools and machines for sheet metal processing; mobile heating solutions; and welding solutions. Further, the company provides tool tethering solutions for the oil, gas, and construction industries; safety and occupational shoes; tools and industrial supplies for construction and industry; gloves; hand protection, hearing, eye, head, respiratory protection, and safety footwear products; personal protective equipment for hearing, head, eye, and respiratory protection; and hand tools and storage solutions. The company was formerly known as B&B Tools AB (publ) and changed its name to Bergman & Beving AB (publ) in June 2017. Bergman & Beving AB (publ) was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
